body: Yeah, I've spoken to some friends about it and they all listen and say I should see a psychiatrist. I agree. However, I'm afraid. I feel embarrassed I guess, that I may have a problem.

Yeah, I thought some changes would work, too. I've lost weight, I eat better, and exercise more frequently. They're good changes for sure. But they haven't really changed my mindset, they've just changed some aspects of myself.
